description: Na₄MgMn₂O₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.44 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.02 Å. Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MnO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.20 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mg and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mg atom.
